column3: The Hebrew describes one who is misled; BSB frames this as a warning not to deceive himself.
The Hebrew says it will be completed without explicitly specifying payment, which BSB supplies.
The Hebrew makes him the active subject of shedding his unripe fruit; BSB describes a vine being stripped.
The Hebrew describes the fire consuming the tents as a completed action; BSB says it will consume them.
The Hebrew says their belly prepares deceit; BSB describes the womb as pregnant with deceit.
